# Design: Bibliothek Entity Browsers (Scriptony-Pattern)

<!-- generated by /pingpong-solution on 2026-08-28; revised same day: keep Library hub -->

## Problem & Intent

Browse in der Bibliothek ist ein flaches Card-Grid ohne Carousel/Liste/Thumbs wie in Scriptony. Abenteuer-Tab nutzt Mocks statt `useProjects`. Charakter-Portraits werden nicht angezeigt. Ziel: **Bibliothek als Hub behalten** (ein Sidebar-Eintrag „Bibliothek“ mit inneren Tabs Charaktere / Abenteuer / Welten), aber **innerhalb** jedes Tabs das Scriptony-Browse-Pattern (Carousel ↔ Liste, Thumbs, Meta-Chips, Empty States) und echte Daten.

## Non-Goals

- Bibliothek **nicht** entfernen; Charaktere/Abenteuer/Welten **nicht** als eigene Sidebar-Top-Level-Tabs
- Kein Hosted-Supabase
- Kein Adventure-Editor-Neuaufbau; kein Cover-Upload-Schema in v1
- Kein Scriptony-Prefetch / Film-Serie-Typen
- Kein URL-Router

## Assumptions

- Outer nav bleibt: Dashboard · **Bibliothek** · Marktplatz (+ Profil)
- Inner tabs bleiben: Charaktere | Abenteuer | Welten
- Abenteuer = `projects` via `useProjects`
- Charakter-Cover = `portraitUrl`; Abenteuer/Welten = Fallback-Thumbs v1
- Shared `EntityBrowser` shell reused by the three Library tabs
- Branch from current `main`

## Research

- Same evidence as prior pingpong; decision change is IA-only (keep hub)
- Scriptony pattern applies **inside** a tab panel, not as top-level routes

## Options Considered

### Option A: YAGNI — nur Grid polieren (rejected if Scriptony UX wanted)
### Option B: Library hub + EntityBrowser in tabs — **recommended**
### Option C: Sidebar-Split (three top-level tabs) — **rejected by user 2026-08-28**

## Decision

**Chosen:** Option B — Keep Bibliothek; upgrade tab content to Scriptony browse.

**Why:** User wants one Library entry in the sidebar; the pain is browse UX and fake adventures, not the hub itself. Avoids mobile nav density and Dashboard deep-link churn from Option C.

## What this means (concrete)

| Layer | Change? | Result |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Sidebar / Bottom nav | **Nein** | Weiter: Home, Bibliothek, Markt, Profil |
| Library shell | **Leicht** | Titel „Meine Bibliothek“, Suche, Tab-Leiste bleiben |
| Tab Charaktere | **Ja** | EntityBrowser: Carousel↔Liste; Portrait-Thumbs; Create/Edit/Delete |
| Tab Abenteuer | **Ja** | Mocks raus → `useProjects`; EntityBrowser; Status-Chips; Open/Join/Create |
| Tab Welten | **Ja** | EntityBrowser; Speziesentwicklung-Chip; bestehender World-Dialog |
| Dashboard | **Minimal** | „Alle anzeigen“ → weiter `library` (optional Tab-Query später) |
| Schema / Migrations | **Nein (v1)** | Keine Cover-Spalten |

## Cross-Domain Sign-Off

| Domain | Status | Note |
|--------|--------|------|
| KISS | ✅ | Weniger Nav-Umbau als Sidebar-Split |
| SOLID | ✅ | Shell in components; hooks unchanged owners |
| DRY | ✅ | One EntityBrowser for three tabs |
| Security | ✅ | No new write surfaces beyond existing CRUD |
| UI/UX | ✅ | Familiar hub + better browse; no 6-item mobile nav |
| Scaling | ✅ | Same list sizes |
| Testability | ✅ | E2E within Library tabs |
| Maintainability | ✅ | Smaller blast radius than Option C |

## Confidence

**95%** — intent corrected; scope clearer and smaller than sidebar-split.

## Implementation Sketch

```
Affected paths:
  src/components/Library.tsx                 (compose tabs + EntityBrowser; wire useProjects)
  src/components/EntityBrowser.tsx           (new)
  src/components/EntityBrowserCard.tsx       (new)
  src/components/Layout.tsx                  (unchanged nav ids — optional icon/label polish only)
  src/App.tsx                                (unchanged views — still `library`)
  src/components/Dashboard.tsx               (optional: unchanged links to library)
  e2e/…                                      (library carousel/list + adventures from projects)

New dependencies: none
Estimated scope: ~600–900 lines (smaller than sidebar-split)
Tests: Playwright Library tabs + view-mode toggle + adventures empty/real
```
